# ui::Launcher

Header: `winui/ui/Launcher.hpp`.

What opens URIs and files with the apps the OS has registered for them. [ui::launch_uri()](namespace-ui.md#launch_uri) and [ui::launch_file()](namespace-ui.md#launch_file) go through it, and so do a hyperlink [Button](../controls/button.md#uibutton)'s and a Hyperlink inline's `navigate_uri`.

There is one for the whole process: the platform's, or a double a test installs with [`ui::testing::set_launcher()`](../testing/namespace-ui-testing.md#set_launcher). App code calls the free functions and never needs the class. It is public so a test double can derive from it.

## ~Launcher

```cpp
virtual ~Launcher() = default
```

## launch_uri

```cpp
virtual void launch_uri(const std::string& uri) = 0
```

Opens `uri`, fire and forget, with its default handler (a browser for http/https, the mail client for mailto, ...). A URI nothing handles is dropped.

## launch_file

```cpp
virtual void launch_file(const std::filesystem::path& file) = 0
```

Opens `file`, fire and forget, with the app registered for its type. A file that does not exist is dropped.
